description: Reads up to sixteen points as a wave, giving the straight lines between them and the bare steps, with the aliasing suppressed

params.text: Sets the pitch, -4 to 4 as a power of two around middle C, which is about 16Hz to 4186Hz
Scales the voltage at the FM jack, 0 to 300 per cent
While on, the FM jack is added to the frequency in hertz rather than to the pitch in octaves, which gives through-zero frequency modulation

inputs.text: Sets the pitch by cable, 1V per octave added to the knob, one channel per voice
The points the wave is drawn through, one point per channel, up to sixteen; two points at least are read whatever is patched
Modulates the frequency through the FM knob; with Lin off it is added to the pitch in octaves, and with Lin on it is added to the frequency itself, which lets it pass through zero

outputs.text: The straight lines from each point to the next, with its constant offset removed
The bare points held one after another, a stepped wave with its constant offset removed

notes: nothing is heard until points are patched into Pts; with that jack empty both outputs are written at 0V
the wave is worked out sixteen times over per sample and averaged, which keeps the steps from aliasing at high pitches

inputs.1:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads a flat wave.
inputs.2:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
